verdict: Render is faithful to the original: same circle, triangle, chord EF, altitude CD and labels; the only visible difference is that the O centre dot is noticeably larger.

issues.description: The dot at the centre O is too large in the render. In the original it is a small dot of roughly 6-7 px; in the render it is roughly 10-11 px at the same scale.
issues.suggestion: Reduce the marker size for point O (for example, use a smaller dot radius or the 'small' point style) so it matches the original's dot.
issues.flaky_reason: opposite verdict in v1: The centre marker at O is much smaller in the render than the filled dot in the original (about 3px vs about 6px radius).
